fixes.explanation: Yes, friend. "When the righteous flourish, the people rejoice, but when the wicked rule, the people groan." The proverb sets two situations side by side, and each one has its own sound. Groan is the word for the second half of the verse, when the wicked rule. Rejoicing is for when the righteous flourish. Same people, two very different sounds, and what changes is who's in charge.
